page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.3xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 6462C processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing consistent processing capabilities.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads. It is suitable for hosting relational databases, in-memory caches, enterprise applications, and data processing tasks that require a larger memory footprint relative to compute capacity.
